native_result.HypoA: In Psychology, both original and replication studies primarily used student subjects (original: 82.4%, replication: 80.9%), but some also included community members (original: 7.4%, replication: 8.8%), anyone (original: 10.3%, replication: 5.9%), or online participants (replication: 4.4%).
native_result.HypoB: 社会心理学领域(social psychology,含 Many Labs 社会/人格类研究;对应数据字段 discipline=='Social')是唯一在原始研究与重复研究中都主要使用学生被试的领域:按唯一原始研究统计 56/68=82.4% 的原始研究与 55/68=80.9% 的重复研究使用学生被试;Cognitive(75.5%/81.6%)与 Economics(94.4%/100.0%)以及任何 project 分组均无法同时匹配这两个数字。

sub_hypo.text: In Psychology, both original and replication studies primarily used student subjects (original: 82.4%, replication: 80.9%), but some also included community members (original: 7.4%, replication: 8.8%), anyone (original: 10.3%, replication: 5.9%), or online participants (replication: 4.4%).
sub_hypo.context: Original and replication studies in Psychology.
sub_hypo.relations: Students predominated in both original (82.4%) and replication (80.9%) studies. Community members accounted for 7.4% of original and 8.8% of replication studies; anyone accounted for 10.3% of original and 5.9% of replication studies; online participants accounted for 4.4% of replication studies.

gold_sub_hypo.full_hypo: In Psychology, both original and replication studies primarily used student subjects (original: 82.4%, replication: 80.9%), but some also included community members (original: 7.4%, replication: 8.8%), anyone (original: 10.3%, replication: 5.9%), or online participants (replication: 4.4%).

sub_hypo.text: 按唯一原始研究统计，社会心理学领域（discipline='Social'，含 Many Labs 社会/人格类研究）的原始研究与重复研究使用学生被试的比例分别为 56/68=82.4% 和 55/68=80.9%，是唯一同时匹配这两个比例的领域。
sub_hypo.context: 使用含被试类型的主表，按 discipline 分组并按 title 去重；重复研究被试类型采用 ANY 规则，即同一研究任一重复记录为 students 即计为使用学生被试。不剔除 drop 或 aggregated 记录；缺失被试类型的研究计入分母并记为非 students。
sub_hypo.relations: Social 组的原始研究学生被试比例为 56/68（82.35%，四舍五入为82.4%），重复研究为 55/68（80.88%，四舍五入为80.9%）；原始侧非学生研究为12/68，重复侧为13/68。唯一性指同时匹配上述两个具体比例，而非只有该领域两侧学生被试均占多数。

sub_hypo.text: Cognitive、Economics 以及任何 project 分组均无法同时匹配原始研究82.4%、重复研究80.9%的学生被试比例；敏感性分析中仅 Social 分组配合 ANY 规则命中目标。
sub_hypo.context: 以主表中的 Cognitive、Economics 和 project 分组作对照；敏感性分析涵盖 discipline/project 分组与 ANY、first-row、all-rows、逐行四种统计规则，共28格。project 分组仅作对照。
sub_hypo.relations: Cognitive 原始/重复研究学生被试比例为75.5%/81.6%，Economics 为94.4%/100.0%；这些领域及任何 project 分组均不能同时匹配82.4%/80.9%。28格敏感性分析中仅 Social+ANY 同时匹配目标比例。
